injuries.comment: The Wizards said on Thursday (Jul. 30) that Watkins underwent surgery to repair a torn ACL and his typical recovery time for the procedure is approximately 9-to-12 months.
The Wizards said on Sunday (Nov. 8) that Vukcevic is OUT indefinitely.
Champagnie underwent foot surgery and is expected to be sidelined for several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
The Wizards announced on Monday (Nov. 2) that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
The Magic reported on Saturday (Oct. 17) that Penda suffered a partially torn right hamstring and there are no updates on a timetable for return yet, per Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel.
Isaac's latest knee setback is unfortunate, but it's encouraging that he's progressing through rehab and remains confident he'll return this season.
The Magic reported on Saturday (Oct. 24) that Banchero will miss approximately 4-6 weeks with a right high ankle sprain.
Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday (Sept. 28) that Nelson remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.
Porter Jr. is Out for Saturday's (Nov. 28) game against the Wizards.
